text: Overseas travel lodging limit. The maximum lodging reimbursement is 180 dollars per night.
For international business trips, employees may claim accommodation expenses up to 220 dollars per night.
International business travel requests must be approved by the department head before departure.
USB storage device purchase requests must include a business justification and a valid cost center.
Personal removable storage devices, including USB flash drives, must not be connected to company computers.
Meal expenses on approved business trips are reimbursed up to 60 dollars per day.
